victoria-peak.name: Victoria Peak
victoria-peak.price_text: Peak Tram return roughly HKD 90–110; Sky Terrace 428 extra; free to walk the trails
victoria-peak.hours: Peak Tram about 07:00–24:00; check on the day
victoria-peak.tip: Go early morning or after dark to skip the worst tram queues, and walk Lugard Road for the free view.

victoria-harbour.name: Victoria Harbour
victoria-harbour.tip: The Symphony of Lights show is around 20:00 nightly; watch from the Tsim Sha Tsui promenade.

tian-tan-buddha.name: Tian Tan Buddha
tian-tan-buddha.price_text: Free to visit the statue; cable car and bus cost extra
tian-tan-buddha.hours: Statue grounds roughly 10:00–17:30; check on the day
tian-tan-buddha.tip: Climb the 268 steps early before tour groups arrive, then see the Po Lin Monastery next door.

avenue-of-stars.name: Avenue of Stars
avenue-of-stars.tip: Best at night for the skyline and light show; the promenade is flat and easy to walk.

star-ferry.name: Star Ferry
star-ferry.price_text: About HKD 4–6 per crossing depending on class
star-ferry.tip: Take the Tsim Sha Tsui to Central route and sit on the upper deck for the harbour view.

man-mo-temple.name: Man Mo Temple
man-mo-temple.tip: The hanging incense coils fill the air with smoke; keep quiet and don't block worshippers.

wong-tai-sin.name: Wong Tai Sin Temple
wong-tai-sin.tip: Reach it by MTR to Wong Tai Sin station; the temple is right at the exit.

bank-of-china-tower.name: Bank of China Tower
bank-of-china-tower.price_text: Free to view from outside; the public viewing floor is often closed
bank-of-china-tower.hours: Exterior always visible; check on the day for access
bank-of-china-tower.tip: Best photographed from the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront or from the Peak Tram lower terminus.

mid-levels-escalators.name: Mid-Levels Escalators
mid-levels-escalators.hours: Runs downhill in the morning, uphill in the afternoon and evening; check on the day
mid-levels-escalators.tip: Ride up and walk down through SoHo for bars, cafes and street art.

ngong-ping-360.name: Ngong Ping 360
ngong-ping-360.price_text: Cable car return roughly HKD 250–350; check on the day
ngong-ping-360.tip: Book online and go early; the glass-bottom cabin costs more but is worth it on a clear day.

aqua-luna.name: Aqua Luna Junk Boat
aqua-luna.price_text: Harbour cruise roughly HKD 200–400; check on the day
aqua-luna.hours: Departures vary by day; check on the day
aqua-luna.tip: Book the sunset sailing for the skyline; drinks are extra.

cuhk.name: Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)
cuhk.hours: Campus generally open daily; check on the day
cuhk.tip: Hilly campus in Sha Tin; take the free shuttle and see the lake and art museum.

cityu.name: City University of Hong Kong
cityu.hours: Campus generally open daily; check on the day
cityu.tip: Near Kowloon Tong MTR; the striking red building is a quick photo stop.

cultural-centre.name: Hong Kong Cultural Centre
cultural-centre.hours: Box office and foyer roughly 09:00–21:00; check on the day
cultural-centre.tip: Check the programme for concerts; the waterfront steps outside are a good rest spot.

disneyland.name: Hong Kong Disneyland
disneyland.price_text: One-day ticket roughly HKD 600–800; check on the day
disneyland.hours: About 10:00–20:00; hours vary, check on the day
disneyland.tip: Buy tickets online, arrive at opening and use the app for wait times.

hong-kong-island.name: Hong Kong Island
hong-kong-island.tip: Use the MTR and the Ding Ding tram to hop between Central, Wan Chai and Causeway Bay.

ocean-park.name: Hong Kong Ocean Park - Grand Aquarium
ocean-park.landmark: Hong Kong Ocean Park - Grand Aquarium
ocean-park.price_text: Park ticket roughly HKD 400–500; check on the day
ocean-park.tip: The Grand Aquarium is indoors and good in rain; go early to beat the crowds.

polyu.name: Hong Kong Polytechnic University
polyu.hours: Campus generally open daily; check on the day
polyu.tip: In Hung Hom, a short walk from the Tsim Sha Tsui East waterfront.

hkust.name: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
hkust.landmark: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
hkust.hours: Campus generally open daily; check on the day
hkust.tip: On a hillside in Clear Water Bay with sea views; a long trip from the city centre.

wetland-park.name: Hong Kong Wetland Park
wetland-park.price_text: Entry roughly HKD 30–60; check on the day
wetland-park.hours: About 10:00–17:00, closed some weekdays; check on the day
wetland-park.tip: Far northwest near Tin Shui Wai; bring binoculars for birds in winter.

icc.name: International Commerce Centre
icc.price_text: Sky100 observation deck roughly HKD 150–200; check on the day
icc.hours: Sky100 about 10:00–21:00; check on the day
icc.tip: Go up at sunset for harbour views from Kowloon side; book online for a small discount.

temple-street-market.name: Temple Street Night Market
temple-street-market.price_text: Free to browse; food and goods priced per stall
temple-street-market.tip: Come hungry for street food and haggle gently on souvenirs.

mong-kok-walk.name: Mong Kok street walk
mong-kok-walk.tip: Walk Ladies' Market and Sai Yeung Choi Street for electronics, clothes and snacks.

dim-sum-lunch.name: Classic dim sum lunch
dim-sum-lunch.price_text: Roughly HKD 100–250 per person; check on the day
dim-sum-lunch.tip: Go before noon on a weekday to avoid queues; order a mix of steamed and fried dishes.

ding-ding-tram.name: Ding Ding tram ride
ding-ding-tram.price_text: About HKD 3 per ride, exact fare
ding-ding-tram.tip: Sit upstairs at the front for a slow, cheap tour of the island's streets.

soho-walk.name: SoHo and Sheung Wan walk
soho-walk.hours: Always open; cafes and bars vary
soho-walk.tip: Wander the lanes for street art, antiques and small cafes; good in the afternoon.

p1881-heritage.name: 1881 Heritage
p1881-heritage.hours: Open-air area roughly 10:00–22:00; check on the day
p1881-heritage.tip: Former marine police HQ turned shops; good for a short photo stop near the Star Ferry.
